svg.aria-label: A grid of 355 small dots, one for every 43-yard field goal attempted in the NFL from 2015 to 2024. Two hundred and eighty-five are green for made and seventy are red for missed. One red dot at the right edge is circled in gold and labelled as Cody Parkey’s kick of 6 January 2019, with the note that it is red now but was no colour at all with ten seconds left.
svg.text: EVERY 43-YARD FIELD GOAL IN TEN NFL SEASONS
355 kicks. 285 went through, 70 did not. The law of large numbers made this picture,
and it is a good picture. It had nothing whatever to say about which dot was yours.
At ten seconds left it was
THE LAW DESCRIBES THE PICTURE. IT DOES NOT DESCRIBE A DOT.
